## Maintenance checklist

- [ ] I checked the Expo SDK 57 documentation for affected Expo/native APIs.
- [ ] I ran `npm test` and `npx tsc --noEmit`.
- [ ] Android and iOS behavior, permissions, and generated prebuild impact were considered.
- [ ] Tokens remain in SecureStore and API calls use the shared Axios client.
- [ ] Navigation keys, feature exports, offline/sync behavior, and types are aligned.
- [ ] User-facing text is updated in en, es, fr, ja, and ru.
- [ ] Shared behavior is coordinated with backend/web/desktop/SPA as needed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` describes the user-visible change.
